scientific_integrity: The line incidence is proved by equations; exact modular rank is a full-row-rank certificate for integer matrices and hence proves the rational cup-product statement. Good-characteristic incidence enumeration is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the complex Fermat cubic and rational cup-product generation; no integral cup-product surjectivity, homotopy classification, or uniform special-cubic theorem is claimed. Similar unpublished or unindexed treatments remain possible.
title: Degree-one generation of the rational cohomology of the 27-line complement on the Fermat cubic
